Name: Raccoon's Mixed Seeds
Author: BeardedRascal
Description:
This simple mod adds two new types of mixed seeds at the Raccoon Wife's Shop.
They can grow all of the Vanilla crops & flowers, with configurable weighting and requirements.
They will unlock after receiving the [i]Raccoon Journal[/i] (2nd shop upgrade, configurable).

By default, for the [i]Raccoon's Mixed Seeds[/i], there's checks for year 2 and locations (i.e. a [i]Garlic Seed[/i] will only be planted if you're in spring on year 2, or when indoors/at the island farm on year 2 for the other seasons; the [i]Oasis[/i] seeds will only be planted if you've already visited the [i]Desert[/i]; same thing for the [i]Ginger Island [/i]crops).
For the [i]Raccoon's Mixed Flower Seeds, [/i]the seasonal limitation has been removed for indoors areas (i.e. planting a [i]Raccoon's Mixed Flower Seed[/i] in the Greenhouse in winter could yield a [i]Poppy Seed[/i]).

You will have to trade Vanilla [i]Mixed Seeds[/i] and [i]Mixed Flower Seeds[/i] at the Raccoon's Wife Shop to obtain them. The cost is configurable.

v1.2.0 added very early/basic support for SVE, East Scrap & Cornucopia seeds and flowers, I'm open to feedback and suggestions.

Requirements : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions Framework[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
This is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[u]Installation / Usage :
[/u]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions Framework[/url]
- Extract the content of this downloaded mod zip file into your [i]Mods[/i] folder.
- Launch the game using SMAPI
- Edit the config.json file or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to configure the mod at your leisure
